fact: Run Plan Review Gate BEFORE implementing work units, not after. The gate catches issues before code is written, preventing rework.
why: Retroactive review found a spec bug that required a fix commit. Pre-implementation review would have caught it sooner.

fact: When a spec lists 'modules in scope', verify each module has corresponding implementation artifacts. Specs written during planning may list modules that don't need artifacts.
why: Permissions spec listed Authentication as in-scope but no authentication:* codes were needed - Auth endpoints are unauthenticated or just require identity.

fact: Alembic down_revision must exactly match the revision string of the parent migration (e.g., '0001_baseline' not '0001'). Mismatched IDs cause KeyError.
why: Migration failed with KeyError: '0001' because parent revision was '0001_baseline'. Exact string match required.

fact: The 3-reviewer Plan Review Gate (Feasibility, Completeness, Scope & Alignment) catches spec inconsistencies that implementation alone would miss.
why: Scope reviewer found Authentication listed in spec but implementation had Seed - a spec bug not visible from code alone.

fact: Authentication module has no permission codes by design. Login is public, GET /auth/me requires authentication but no specific permission. Don't add placeholder permissions.
why: Adding unused authentication:* permissions would be scope creep. Auth endpoints gate on identity existence, not permission codes.
